limitations: CPU-only run: generator is Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct, not a 3-8B model.
Transformations are round-trip machine translation only; learned paraphrasers (DIPPER) and human editing are not covered.
EXP detection uses the alignment-free context-seeded variant; the edit-distance aligned detector of Kuditipudi et al. is not implemented.
Sentence-wise translation preserves document structure but is itself a modelling choice that slightly favours retention.
